note: Fields under `derived` are computed by this project, not published by the lab. Everything else is recorded from a primary source; a null means no source stated it, never zero.

fields.name: Model name as the atlas records it. Primary key.
fields.type: Atlas tiering: Frontier, Mid or SLM.
fields.params: Total parameters as published, e.g. '1T'. '—' = not disclosed.
fields.active: Parameters active per token. Equals total on dense models.
fields.attn: Attention mechanism. Key into the attention menu.
fields.maxOut: Max output tokens, null where unpublished.
fields.intel: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. Third-party. Read intelVersion before comparing two models: the column holds figures from two versions of the index.
fields.intelVersion: The version of the AA Intelligence Index the intel figure was measured under. AA re-based the index at v4.2 and again at v4.3 by adding harder evaluations rather than re-testing, which moved every score down 12-18 points, and it has re-rated only some of these models. A '4.1' figure and a '4.3' figure are not on the same scale and must not be compared, ranked or averaged together. null where intel is null.
fields.codingAgent: Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index. Third-party. Scores an agent harness driving the model, not the model alone, so it is only meaningful together with codingAgentVia. Read codingAgentVersion before comparing two models: the column holds figures from two versions of the index.
fields.codingAgentVersion: The version of the AA Coding Agent Index the codingAgent figure was measured under. AA re-based it from v1.3 to v1.5 by swapping Terminal-Bench v2 for v4 and DeepSWE for v1.1, which moved every re-rated pairing down 7-16 points, and it has re-rated only some of these models. A '1.3' figure and a '1.5' figure are not on the same scale and must not be compared, ranked or averaged together. null where codingAgent is null.
fields.codingAgentVia: The agent harness that produced codingAgent — the highest-scoring pairing AA publishes for this model.
fields.vision: MMMU-Pro percentage as published by Artificial Analysis. Third-party, and a single benchmark rather than an index — none of intel, codingAgent or agentic includes a vision evaluation, so a null here is common on models that lead those.
fields.agentic: Artificial Analysis Agentic Index. Third-party. Shares two of its component evaluations with the Intelligence Index, so the two are not independent.
fields.training: Array of stages: {label, tokens, detail, curriculum}. null = none published.
fields.trainingSource: Set when the pipeline shown belongs to another model; those tokens are never counted as disclosed.
fields.spec: Read from the model's own config.json on Hugging Face: layers, hidden, heads, headDim (head_dim as published, which is usually not hidden/heads), experts, ffn (dense and per-expert intermediate_size), activation (hidden_act verbatim), norm, vocab, window, posEmb.
fields.report: URL of the technical report or model card.
fields.derived: Computed metrics; each carries the formula used.
